summary: Architectural blueprint for refactoring the application into a multi-channel outreach command center with 5 global top navigation buttons, isolated channel workspaces (Email, Instagram, Facebook), 5 internal sub-pages per channel (Leads with DnD sortable table, DM custom pitch editor, Schedule date assignment, Follow-up Schedule with overdue alerts, Mockup screenshot upload/preview/download), Executive Dashboard, Insights & Analysis, and persistent IndexedDB + Firebase data storage.
